'''Sergeant Vandal''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SecuringtheLandingZone" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Biography==
During the [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] [[Separatist War|Civil War]], Vandal was able to coordinate an attack on the [[Separatist stronghold]] housed within [[Mount Avilatan]].<ref name="SecuringtheLandingZone" />
